title: STT Response Contract (v1)
description: Response of POST /stt/transcribe (and alias /transcribe) — STT-001. Consumed as-is by EXT-006 TRANSCRIBE and AND-004 VoiceClient.

transcript.description: Recognized speech text (may be empty when nothing was said).

language.description: BCP-47-ish language code actually used/detected. `auto` requests detection; the response always reports a concrete value (or `unknown` when the backend cannot detect).

confidence.description: 0..1 average confidence when the backend reports one; 0.0 when unknown.

duration_sec.description: Audio duration in seconds when known; 0.0 when unknown.
